game.title: Eternal Alchemy
grounds.title: Grounds
grounds.garden.subtitle: You plant it. Tending is a bonus, never a duty.
grounds.cave.subtitle: You tend it. The mycelium spreads on its own; light decides what wins.
grounds.shaft.subtitle: You dig it. Veins run out, so you go deeper.
cave.grid.hint: Pick a tool, then tap a tile
shaft.needBeams: Buy support beams before digging deeper.
hero.ilse.blurb: A delver who reads barrow-stone like a page.
hero.corin.blurb: A hunter, and the only one who likes the Emberwaste.
hero.maren.blurb: A forager who comes back with more than she was sent for.
hero.bexley.blurb: Keeps a running list of everything owed to them. It is long.
hero.corvin.blurb: Talks to the birds. Insists this is a professional technique.
hero.dalla.blurb: Slow to leave, slower to turn back. Arrives with everything.
hero.emrick.blurb: Was a cooper once. Still judges every barrel he passes.
hero.fenna.blurb: Sleeps anywhere, wakes at anything. A useful pair of habits.
hero.garrow.blurb: Carries twice what he is asked to and mentions it twice as often.
hero.hesper.blurb: Draws maps that are wrong in interesting and consistent ways.
hero.ivo.blurb: Has never once been the first back, or the last.
hero.jorun.blurb: Reads weather off the light. Has been right more than not.
hero.kestrel.blurb: Fast, and aware of it. Slower company finds this tiring.
hero.lomax.blurb: Would rather go round than through, and usually saves time.
hero.mirren.blurb: Notices the thing everyone else walked past an hour ago.
hero.nessa.blurb: Counts everything into the bag and everything out of it.
hero.oswin.blurb: Cheerful in bad weather, which others find either warming or unbearable.
hero.perrin.blurb: Trades for what the party needs before anyone knows they need it.
hero.quill.blurb: Writes it all down. Will read it back to you, unprompted.
hero.rhosyn.blurb: Handles everything as though it might be worth something. Often right.
hero.sable.blurb: Speaks about twice a day and is worth listening to both times.
hero.tarn.blurb: Built like a doorway and about as easy to move.
hero.ulla.blurb: Was a cook. The party eats well and complains about nothing else.
hero.verity.blurb: Cannot be talked into a shortcut. This has saved several lives.
hero.wick.blurb: Keeps a lamp burning long after the others have given up on the light.
hero.yarrow.blurb: Patches people up on the trail and pretends it was nothing.
hero.zeph.blurb: Young, quick, and entirely convinced of both.
hero.alder.blurb: The oldest hand here, and still the one who packs properly.
hero.briar.blurb: Comes back scratched to pieces holding exactly what was asked for.
hero.calla.blurb: Hums the whole way out. Silent the whole way back.
hero.dunn.blurb: Never hurries and has somehow never been late.
hero.elowen.blurb: Talks to the plants. The plants appear to cooperate.
hero.fitch.blurb: Can get into anywhere. Getting him out again is the harder trick.
hero.greer.blurb: Argues with the plan, follows it exactly, then says nothing.
hero.halla.blurb: Laughs at the worst moments, which turns out to help.
hero.ines.blurb: Keeps the party together by refusing to acknowledge that it might not.
hero.joss.blurb: Lost a boot on the first outing and has told the story ever since.
hero.karrin.blurb: Tests every branch before she trusts it, including the ones indoors.
hero.linnet.blurb: Small, quiet, and back before anyone noticed she had gone.
hero.marlow.blurb: Would like it on record that he did suggest the other route.
hero.sela.blurb: Knows the mirefen by smell. Has never once been lost.
hero.hark.blurb: Digs where others walk past. Talks about it at length.
hero.orlin.blurb: Climbs the spires for the view, and brings things back.
hero.wren.blurb: Gentle hands, thin bones. Finds what the barrow hides.
biome.emberwaste.blurb: Ash flats and salamander nests. Ignis country.
biome.mirefen.blurb: Standing water and pearl beds. Aqua country.
biome.sunkenBarrow.blurb: Old graves and older stone. Terra and Umbra.
biome.skyreachSpires.blurb: Wind-cut towers. Aer, and a long climb.
roster.title: Roster
roster.subtitle: Hard workers, provide supplies to assist in their endeavors.
roster.heroes.allOut: Everyone is out on the road.
potionInfo.supplyBonus: Reads as grades better on an expedition
potionInfo.use.favourite: {heroes} favour it, and gain extra favour when it is packed.
potionInfo.use.contract: An open contract asks for this.
reward.nothing: They came back with nothing but the walk.
roster.supplies.empty: Nothing bottled to send with them.
roster.tavern.empty: Nobody else is looking for work.
board.title: Board
board.subtitle: Standing orders. Bigger money than the shelf, if you can meet the terms.
board.empty: The board is bare. Something will be posted soon.
board.abandon.title: Abandon this contract?
board.abandon.bodyDelivered: The order for {count} × {recipe} is forfeit, and the {delivered} already delivered against it are not returned.
equipment.dryingRack.detail: Dries a harvest on demand, which is what Powder needs.
equipment.greenhouse.detail: Two more beds, and lets you cross plants into new strains.
equipment.vesselMoulds.detail: Make your own vessels rather than buying them.
greenhouse.title: Greenhouse
greenhouse.hint: Pick two parents. The child sits midway between them.
greenhouse.mutationNote: A cross sometimes throws a trait neither parent had.
haggle.result.counter: That struck home — they reconsider their footing.
haggle.result.backfire: Exactly the wrong thing to say.
haggle.result.holdFirm: You let the silence do the work.
codex.title: Mastery Codex
codex.deftHands.detail: You can feel when the heat is right.
codex.deepVeins.detail: You know where to dig by now.
codex.oldFriends.detail: Merchants remember you from the last town.
codex.rememberedRecipes.detail: Your old notes come in handy.
codex.fullPurse.detail: Investing gets easier the second time.
prestige.title: Branch Out
prestige.body: Branch into another location and open another shop. Everything goes but the Codex.
prestige.locked: Branching out opens at the highest rank.
prestige.confirmBody: This shop ends here. You keep your Mastery and Codex, and open in {town}. There is no undo.
town.hollowreach.blurb: Caves for miles, and cheap trade
merchant.bramm.blurb: Staples, seeds and the plain fittings. Never exciting, always here.
merchant.vessa.blurb: Exotic reagents and the good equipment, priced accordingly.
merchant.hesk.blurb: An outfitter. Beams, beds, moulds and presses — nothing you can drink, everything that makes room for more of it.
merchant.ashwalker.blurb: Takes no coin. Trades only for sealed potions, and carries what nobody else will sell.
market.title: Market
market.subtitle: Who is in town, and what they brought.
market.closed: Nobody is trading right now. Merchants keep daylight hours — except one.
market.error.gone: They have packed up and gone
market.error.potions: Not enough sealed potions of that grade
equipment.plotFive.detail: Breaks new ground for one more crop.
equipment.plotSix.detail: One more bed, once the fifth is dug.
equipment.richLoam.detail: Better soil returns more seed from every harvest.
equipment.cauldronOneEighty.detail: Holds 180 essence. Greater potions become possible.
equipment.wideRim.detail: Room for twelve ingredients rather than eight.
equipment.lagged.detail: Holds its heat — the pot cools half as fast.
equipment.shelfFive.detail: One more thing on display at a time.
garden.title: Garden
garden.subtitle: Tending is a bonus, never a duty.
garden.seeds.source: Recovered when harvesting · sold by merchants
garden.seeds.empty: No seeds. Harvest a plot to recover some.
garden.plots.hint: Tap a seed, then Plant — or drag a seed onto a plot

cauldron.brewing.hint: Leave it to work. It keeps brewing while you're away.
cauldron.bottle.hint: Form, vessel, seal — all three are yours to choose
equipment.standingOrders.detail: Set a basket a merchant brings every visit.
equipment.caveBeds.detail: Six more tiles for the cave to spread across.
equipment.humidityWard.detail: Damp air. The mycelium spreads faster.
equipment.steelPick.detail: One more piece of ore from every batch.
equipment.supportBeams.detail: Shore up another 20 metres. The seams below need them.
equipment.heroSlotTwo.detail: Room for one more hero on the roster.
market.standing.hint: Set a basket they bring every visit

onboarding.step.brew: Accept the outcome to start brewing.
onboarding.step.stock: Put it out on a shelf.
onboarding.step.sell: Wait for someone to buy it.

shop.shelves.hint: Drag a bottle onto a shelf, or tap one to stock it
shop.inventory.hint: Everything you've bottled and not yet put out
shop.inventory.empty: Nothing bottled yet. Brew something at the cauldron.
shop.tip.stock: Tap to stock the first free shelf.
shop.decor.hint: Five spots. Tap a piece to put it out, tap it again to take it down.

away.parties: {count} parties are home, waiting to hand over what they found.

ledger.subtitle: Overview of the shop.

settings.textSize.hint: Applies on top of your device's own setting.
settings.save.local: Saves are stored on this device only, export to be able to move between devices.
settings.save.failed: That file isn't a valid save.

settings.newGame.hint: Wipes your save and start fresh.
settings.newGame.confirmBody: This deletes your current save, export the save first if you want to keep it.
debug.title: Debug
decor.verdantBanner.detail: Green cloth on the long wall.
decor.crimsonBanner.detail: Red, and hard to walk past.
decor.azureBanner.detail: Bright enough to see from the lane.
decor.violetBanner.detail: The colour nobody else can afford.
decor.goldGoblet.detail: A little too fine to use.
decor.skullChalice.detail: Customers argue a good deal less.
equipment.shelfBoard.detail: One more shelf on the wall. Buy as many as the wall will hold.
cauldron.buy.title: Another pot
cauldron.buy.hint: A second cauldron brews a second thing at the same time.
cauldron.buy.full: The bench is full. There is nowhere to put another.
cauldron.buy.locked: Nothing you can buy yet. Renown opens the better pots.
ingredientInfo.noEssence: No essence at all. Useful for bulk, nothing else.
ingredientInfo.suitsNothing: Suits no recipe on its own. Blend it with something else.
ingredientInfo.undiscovered: And {count} more you have not brewed yet.
ingredientInfo.stable: Never ages. A mineral is as good in a month as it is today.
goods.appealOverride: Sets shelf appeal to {percent}% — villagers will not buy it.
goods.supplyGrade: Counts one grade higher as expedition supplies.
goods.shelfStack: Stacks up to {count} per shelf slot.
goods.barter: Worth {times}× when bartering with the Ashwalker.
goods.boardFitting: Fitted to a shelf of your choosing, in the Shop.
